The Bonding Rite formalizes the mating bond; a brutal mating bite is publicly witnessed and scents are permanently blended, officiated by a Moon Speaker. The Pack Adoption Rite integrates new members; the adopted wolf receives absolute pack bites and is physically scented by every single pack member.

Axis 2: Secondary Sex (immutable biology) — Primordial Enigma (Firstborn only), Ascended Enigma (rare), Alpha, Delta, Beta, Omega. Axis 3: Pack Role (authority, mutable) — Pack Leader, Second, Hunter Captain, Caretakers, Pups. Axis 4: Social Status (politics, mutable) — House Head, Lord, Knight, Citizen. Axis 5: Profession (occupation, chosen) — Blacksmith, Doctor, Engineer, Soldier, Pilot. Axis 6: Niche (specialization, developed) — Weaponsmith, Field Medic, Cryptographer, Diplomat, Tracker. No axis determines another; Biology is not Destiny (Principle I).

entries.content: The LSE framework defines three absolute epistemological levels of truth that must never be conflated. Religious Canon represents divine truth taught by the Faith of Fenris, stating Fenris forged the Nine Firstborn from mortal warriors; this does not guarantee historical fact. Recorded History comprises verified events supported by hard evidence; historians confirm the earliest werewolves emerged in the Viking Age as nine individuals called the Firstborn. Separately, Canon Policy establishes a hierarchy: Core Canon (LSE modules) supersedes Setting Canon (world-specific content), which supersedes Narrative Canon (roleplay events).

entries.content: LSE Core Rules establish three foundational principles. Principle I — Biology is not Destiny: Secondary Sex (Alpha, Delta, Beta, Omega, Enigma) dictates only physiology, pheromones, and reproductive cycles; it never determines social rank, profession, political authority, or personal value. Principle II — Packs are Families: A werewolf pack is a cooperative family unit built on kinship, mutual care, and shared survival; packs are never military hierarchies founded on violence or dominance. Principle III — Leadership is Earned and Maintained: Pack Leaders secure authority through trust, competence, and pack consent; leadership is never an automatic birthright for any Secondary Sex and is forfeited through incompetence or abuse.
